Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1301
Claimant:
Connie Crane
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
August 28, 2024
Reported side impact at a signalized intersection. The claimant is not represented and was seen at the scene
complaining of back pain. Police attended and confirmed the claimant was seated in the vehicle when it was struck.
September 25, 2024
Scene photos show the point of impact on the driver side panel and roughly match the description given on the first
call. The only other people present were passengers and a passing motorist, and no independent witness has come
forward.
October 26, 2024
Damage to the vehicle appears largely in line with a side impact of the described type. No prior damage to this vehicle
is recorded in our file or shown in the photos reviewed.
January 4, 2025
Claimant reports back strain and attended urgent care the same day. The presentation fits the kind and force of this
crash well, and no earlier injury to the same area is known.
January 16, 2025
When re-contacted, the claimant added a few small details, such as the approach speed and lane position, but the
core account has not changed. Coverage records show the policy was in force at the time of loss, and nothing
suggests the damage predates it.
February 11, 2025
The driver is not named on the policy and does not live with the policyholder. The claimant has given a statement
about permission to drive, and verification of that permission is pending.
April 13, 2025
Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the claimant improved. The injury component remains under
review based on the medical records received so far.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
